basis: A body walk is a pure function of the body bytes, the drain LexerConfig and the channel; base and report_at change only cut offsets.
Key = whole-image span (origin+base+body) + normalised drain LexerConfig (every dialect axis is Hash/Eq) + channel; the memo binds to one image, and anchored proves local == whole[origin..].
Bodies are recorded only when their Words frame is exhausted; cuts, Parts fallbacks and Err return early and are never recorded.
The parse-cut walk is unbounded; lexer and structural-index depth caps count depth within the scanned buffer, so MAX_SOURCE_NEST_DEPTH cannot make a clean body unclean.
Descendants are recorded before their parent, so a skip omits no state.
exactness.theoretical_gap: arena.bytes(body)==None for a span already keyed clean would turn Err(SourceBounds) into a skip; unreachable because arena body spans lie inside their own image
